audit.whatIsWrong: Content used a fabricated ability name 'Spirit Needle' in four fields (her E is The Weirding) and called her Q a 'Twisted Fate-style bounce' (Twofold Hex is a send-and-recall missile); breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; her Spirit Abjuration sustain (missingInteractions) was nowhere on the page; many fields misgender her as he/him.
audit.why: Kit file: Q Twofold Hex 9s recall missile, W Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18 leap + invisibility, E The Weirding 15/14/13/12/11 slow + hop-back, R Between Worlds 140/120/100; P exorcised spirits heal her.
audit.corrected: All 'Spirit Needle' instances replaced with The Weirding; Q description corrected; cooldowns rewritten with 22s/15s/140s; sustain note added to breakdown.early; pronouns fixed throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: No durations for the punish windows.
audit.why: Across the Veil's 22s rank-1 downtime is the kill window; with E (15s) also down she has no disengage.

notes: Fabricated ability name 'Spirit Needle' killed in all four content fields — her E is The Weirding; also corrected the 'Twisted Fate-style bounce' description of Twofold Hex (it is a send-and-recall missile per the kit). Level chart moved on the full layer only; content win[] already matched the packet, so no win[] edits. Her W is a leap into invisibility, not a blink — I corrected it where rewriting but left 'blink' standing in content whys[3]/mid/wants fields whose rows I was not otherwise touching, to keep scope contained; flagging for a future pass. Spirit Abjuration sustain covered in breakdown.early; Grievous Wounds timing could not fit report[8] (not lint-flagged, band-tight) — recorded here: an Oblivion Orb component before extended-trade phases pays off against her spirit healing.
